title: Swiss Alpine Wonder (6N/7D)
tagline: Snow peaks of Mount Titlis, cogwheel train to the Top of Europe at Jungfraujoch, and glassy waters of Lake Lucerne.

bestTime.notes: May through September brings verdant alpine meadows, blooming wildflowers, and mild hiking weather (18°C to 25°C); December offers magical snow-draped ski landscapes.

visaInfo: Schengen Visa (Short-stay Type C) required for Indian passport holders. Our visa operations desk provides comprehensive document checklists and appointment guidance.
overview: Immerse yourself in postcard-perfect alpine panoramas on infiYATRA's flagship holiday across Switzerland. Begin in cosmopolitan Zurich, strolling along the picturesque Limmat River and taking an excursion to Europe's most powerful waterfall, the roaring Rhine Falls. Journey along pristine lakeside rail lines to charming Lucerne, crossing the historic 14th-century wooden Chapel Bridge and ascending to the glacier paradise of Mount Titlis via the world's first revolving Rotair cable car. Continue into the Bernese Oberland heartland of Interlaken, nestled between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz. Board the iconic cogwheel railway winding up to Jungfraujoch—the Top of Europe at 3,454 meters—to step onto eternal Aletsch Glacier ice and wander through glowing Ice Palace tunnels. Featuring confirmed first-class Swiss Travel Pass passes for seamless trains and scenic lake steamers, verified four-star central hotels, daily buffet breakfasts, and expert local logistics, this journey brings alpine dreams to life with Swiss precision.
highlights: Ascend Mount Titlis on the world's first revolving Rotair 360-degree cable car
Cogwheel train ascent to Jungfraujoch (Top of Europe) and Ice Palace at 3,454m
Witness Europe's largest waterfall, the roaring Rhine Falls at Schaffhausen
Scenic lake steamer cruise across glassy blue waters of Lake Lucerne
Historic medieval Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke) and Lion Monument in Lucerne
Leisure walk through the picturesque alpine resort village of Grindelwald
First-class Swiss Travel Pass included for unlimited trains, boats, and city trams

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich & Old Town Evening Promenade
itinerary.description: Touch down at Zurich International Airport (ZRH), where your Swiss rail host meets you with your Swiss Travel Pass. Take a smooth 12-minute train directly into Zurich Hauptbahnhof and check into your handpicked 4-star city hotel. In the late afternoon, embark on a scenic walking tour through Zurich's charming historic Altstadt (Old Town). Wander cobblestone lanes flanking the Limmat River, admire the twin Romanesque spires of Grossmünster cathedral, and stroll down world-famous Bahnhofstrasse, renowned for luxury horology and Swiss chocolatiers. Enjoy a welcoming Swiss fondue and multi-course dinner.
itinerary.transferInfo: Swiss Rail Train Transfer (Airport to City Center, 12 mins)

itinerary.title: Rhine Falls Natural Wonder & Historic Stein am Rhein
itinerary.description: After a rich buffet breakfast, take a scenic northward train to Schaffhausen to witness the roaring grandeur of the Rhine Falls, Europe's most powerful natural waterfall. Feel the spray of thunderous tumbling glacial waters on a boat ride right up to the central rock bastion in the middle of the falls. Continue to the storybook medieval village of Stein am Rhein, famous for its exceptionally preserved painted half-timbered merchant houses and peaceful riverfront cafes. Return to Zurich by late afternoon to relax by Lake Zurich before dinner.
itinerary.transferInfo: Swiss Rail Panorama Route (Zurich - Schaffhausen - Zurich, approx. 45 mins each way)

itinerary.title: Scenic Train to Lucerne, Chapel Bridge & Lake Steamer Cruise
itinerary.description: Board a scenic morning train tracing sparkling Lake Zug toward Lucerne, nestled beneath the imposing pyramid peaks of Mount Pilatus. Check in to your lakeside hotel and explore the city on foot. Walk across the 14th-century wooden Chapel Bridge adorned with medieval ceiling paintings, visit the poignant Lion Monument carved into natural sandstone cliff, and stroll the lakeside promenade. In the late afternoon, board a historic paddle steamer for a relaxing 1-hour cruise across Lake Lucerne's fjord-like bays, admiring mountain reflections on the water before dinner.
itinerary.transferInfo: Swiss Rail Train (Zurich to Lucerne, 50 mins)

itinerary.title: Mount Titlis Glacier Expedition: Rotair & Cliff Walk
itinerary.description: Take the scenic train to the alpine valley town of Engelberg and board a series of cable cars, culminating in the world's first revolving Titlis Rotair, which rotates a full 360 degrees as you ascend to 3,020 meters altitude. Step out onto eternal snow to cross the Titlis Cliff Walk—Europe's highest suspension bridge—hanging 500 meters above the abyss. Venture deep inside the natural Glacier Cave carved 20 meters beneath the ice surface, and ride the Ice Flyer chairlift over glacial crevasses. Return to Lucerne in the late afternoon for dinner.
itinerary.transferInfo: Scenic Train + Cable Car Network (Engelberg Valley, 45 mins train)

itinerary.title: GoldenPass Scenic Railway to Interlaken & Grindelwald
itinerary.description: Embark on the world-renowned GoldenPass panoramic train, winding past three turquoise mountain lakes and climbing the Brunig Pass into Interlaken, the adventure hub nestled between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz. Check into your alpine hotel and take a regional train into the breathtaking glacier valley of Grindelwald. Stroll through the village under the shadow of the sheer North Face of the Eiger, taking in flower-adorned Swiss chalets and listening to cowbells echoing across meadows. Return to Interlaken for a stroll along the Hohematte park before dinner.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch: Top of Europe Cogwheel Train at 3,454m
itinerary.description: Prepare for the pinnacle of your Swiss holiday. Board the modern Eiger Express tricable gondola from Grindelwald Terminal, soaring directly past the Eiger North Face to Eigergletscher station. Transfer to the historic electric cogwheel train burrowing through the Eiger mountain to Jungfraujoch at 3,454 meters, Europe's highest railway station. Step out onto the Sphinx Observation Deck for jaw-dropping views of the 23-kilometer Great Aletsch Glacier, explore the illuminated Ice Palace, and visit the Lindt Swiss Chocolate Heaven before returning to Interlaken for a celebratory gala dinner.
itinerary.transferInfo: Mountain Railway & Gondola Network (Full day excursion)

itinerary.title: Interlaken to Zurich Airport & Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed Swiss breakfast featuring alpine cheeses, artisan pastries, and hot chocolate. Use your Swiss Travel Pass to board the direct intercity train from Interlaken Ost back to Zurich International Airport (ZRH). Savor final glimpses of snowy peaks, mirror-like lakes, and peaceful pastures from your comfortable panoramic carriage before boarding your international flight back home with cherished memories of Switzerland.
itinerary.transferInfo: Direct Swiss Intercity Train (Interlaken to Zurich Airport, approx. 2 hours 15 mins)

faqs.question: Do Indian travelers need a visa for Switzerland?
faqs.answer: Yes, Indian citizens require a valid Schengen Visa. Our visa documentation desk provides personalized appointment booking assistance, verified cover letters, and insurance vouchers.

faqs.question: How does the Swiss Travel Pass work for transport?
faqs.answer: The Swiss Travel Pass provides seamless hop-on hop-off access on all Swiss national trains, city trams, buses, and scenic lake ferries without having to buy separate tickets for each journey.

faqs.question: Is Jungfraujoch excursion included in the price?
faqs.answer: Yes, full return tickets for the modern Eiger Express gondola and electric cogwheel train to the Top of Europe at 3,454 meters, including the Ice Palace and Sphinx Terrace, are included.

faqs.question: Can I find vegetarian and Indian food in Switzerland?
faqs.answer: Yes! Switzerland is extremely welcoming to Indian travelers. Cities like Zurich, Lucerne, and Interlaken feature numerous authentic Indian restaurants as well as vegetarian-friendly cafes.

faqs.question: Is luggage transfer between cities manageable by train?
faqs.answer: Yes, Swiss trains feature spacious luggage racks at coach entrances and overhead. In addition, Swiss rail offers station-to-station luggage forward services if you prefer hands-free travel.

faqs.question: What is the local currency and are credit cards accepted?
faqs.answer: The currency is the Swiss Franc (CHF). International Visa and Mastercard credit and debit cards, as well as forex cards, are accepted virtually everywhere, even for minor purchases.
